purpose: Resolve the exact 'actual capital' claim and quantify the live FXRP/RLUSD collateral market using Flare's published architecture, Morpho's protocol UI and an independent Morpho API/blockchain aggregator.

forecast.reason: Collateral utilization and concentration describe credit-market structure and liquidation risk, not a calibrated directional XRP price forecast.

claims.statement: Flare describes FXRP as a 1:1 representation minted only after Flare data protocols verify an XRPL payment, backed by an overcollateralized system of independent agents.
claims.interpretation: FXRP is not additional native XRP supply; it is a claim/representation supported by a separate collateral and agent system.
limitations: This mechanism description is from Flare; independent agent-level collateral balances and solvency are not included in this snapshot.

claims.statement: Flare says FXRP's backing XRP remains on XRPL in a Core Vault, with excess XRP time-locked in native XRPL escrows releasing one batch per day.
claims.interpretation: The backing asset remains on XRPL while FXRP is used on Flare/Ethereum; mint/redemption and agent operations create cross-system dependencies.
limitations: Core Vault balances, agent collateral ratios and redemption queues were not independently retrieved in this run.

claims.statement: Flare's September 24, 2026 one-year report says approximately 145.2M FXRP was minted, 130M FXRP was deployed in DeFi and about 7.8M transactions had occurred.
claims.interpretation: Project-reported deployed balance is more informative than minted supply alone, but is not an independently reconciled net external capital measure.
limitations: No address-level deduplication, protocol-by-protocol decomposition or independent proof of all deployed balances is attached.

claims.statement: Flare says approximately 21M FXRP was on other chains through OFT, equal to 14.4% of the reported 145.2M outstanding.
claims.interpretation: Cross-chain representations must not be added again to native XRP or total FXRP supply.
limitations: The destination-chain distribution and canonical supply reconciliation are not included here.

claims.statement: Flare describes FXRP use in lending, collateral, stablecoin backing and yield vaults, including Kinetic, Enosys, Firelight, Spectra, Clearstar and other strategies.
claims.interpretation: XRP exposure is being used in several DeFi primitives; the amount and risk differ by product.
limitations: Project ecosystem descriptions are not independent proof of each protocol's current TVL or solvency.

claims.statement: Flare's September 24 report says a direct XRPL-wallet path to borrow RLUSD and deliver it back to an XRPL address or exchange/bank deposit address is still a next-phase direction.
claims.interpretation: Do not claim the entire XRPL-to-RLUSD borrowing path is live merely because FXRP/RLUSD borrowing is live on Ethereum.
limitations: Existing one-signature wallet paths for vaults are distinct from the still-open direct borrow-and-return path.

claims.statement: Flare announced on 2026-08-03 that an isolated FXRP/RLUSD market was live on Morpho Blue on Ethereum mainnet, curated through Sentora's RLUSD Main vault.
claims.interpretation: This is a direct XRP-representation-to-Ripple-stablecoin collateral/credit connection.
limitations: Market existence is independently visible in Morpho's interface; product risk review details remain partly curator/project-reported.

claims.statement: Flare says borrowers mint FXRP, bridge to Ethereum, post it as collateral and borrow RLUSD; the market is permissionless and isolated, with a market-specific oracle and liquidation LTV.
claims.interpretation: FXRP/RLUSD is an isolated credit market, not a pooled cross-collateral guarantee for all Sentora vault positions.
limitations: Liquidation can force FXRP sales/seizure even if the borrower intended to keep XRP exposure.

claims.statement: Flare says Sentora reviewed FXRP market behavior, oracle reliability and liquidation liquidity before accepting it as collateral.
claims.interpretation: Institutional curation is evidence of a risk review, not a guarantee of collateral safety.
limitations: The full independent risk report, oracle stress tests and ongoing monitoring outputs were not retrieved.

claims.statement: MorphoWatch's 2026-11-02 17:21 UTC snapshot reports USD 9.35M (9.36M RLUSD) supplied to the FXRP/RLUSD market and USD 8.45M borrowed.
claims.interpretation: This is actual deployed loan-market capital reported from Morpho's public API and blockchain, not a project roadmap or market-cap estimate.
limitations: MorphoWatch is an independent aggregator, not Morpho Labs; raw API payload and cryptographic hash were not captured.

claims.statement: The same snapshot reports 90.3% utilization and approximately USD 907K available to borrow.
claims.interpretation: The market is relatively highly utilized and has limited immediate borrowing liquidity compared with outstanding debt.
limitations: Liquidity can change quickly with repayments, new supply and rate movements.

claims.statement: The market reports 13.49M FXRP collateral valued at approximately USD 16.84M, across 57 borrowers.
claims.interpretation: Aggregate collateral coverage is above the 77% liquidation LTV, but borrower-level concentration and price paths matter more than the aggregate alone.
limitations: Derived ratios use rounded aggregator values and current oracle marks.

claims.statement: The market's liquidation LTV is 77%, liquidation bonus is 7.41%, current borrow APY is 7.92%, and supply APY is 7.12%.
claims.interpretation: At high utilization, variable borrowing costs can rise; liquidators receive an incentive to repay debt and seize collateral.
limitations: Rates are instantaneous and not fixed borrower costs.

claims.statement: Two liquidations occurred in the last 30 days with approximately USD 1.7K debt repaid; Morpho's interface reports zero realized and unrealized bad debt at capture.
claims.interpretation: Liquidations are real and observable but small relative to market debt; no bad debt is reported at this capture.
limitations: Zero reported bad debt does not mean no liquidation risk or no future losses.

claims.statement: MorphoWatch estimates approximately USD 256K of FXRP collateral would be at risk under a 20% decline in FXRP/RLUSD price, using current loans and oracle prices.
claims.interpretation: This is a modelled stress exposure, not a prediction, realized liquidation or guaranteed sale amount.
limitations: Borrowers can repay, add collateral or be liquidated before/after the scenario; market depth and slippage are not included in the displayed estimate.

claims.statement: The three largest borrowers owe approximately USD 3.15M, USD 2.91M and USD 1.61M, with reported health factors 1.681, 1.501 and 1.272 respectively.

derived_calculation.label: approximately 90.9% of market debt held by the three largest borrowers

claims.interpretation: Borrower concentration is high; the third-largest position is materially closer to liquidation than the first two.
limitations: Wallet labels are pseudonymous; beneficial ownership and common control are unknown.

claims.statement: MorphoWatch reports a RedStone XRP/FXRP market-price feed with 6-hour heartbeat and 0.25% deviation setting, and a Chainlink RLUSD/USD feed with 1-day heartbeat and 0.3% deviation setting.
claims.interpretation: Oracle freshness and source dependencies are material to collateral risk; a heartbeat is a maximum update condition, not a promise of a new price every instant.
limitations: Full oracle configuration and failover behavior require direct contract/source review.

claims.statement: Sentora RLUSD Main vault had approximately USD 410.3M deposits from 358 depositors at the 2026-11-02 09:01 UTC MorphoWatch snapshot; approximately USD 40.19M (10%) was immediately withdrawable.
claims.interpretation: The wider RLUSD vault is much larger than the FXRP market; vault liquidity is not equal to market-specific FXRP liquidity.
limitations: Depositor and withdrawal figures are a time-specific snapshot.

claims.statement: MorphoWatch reports approximately USD 9.26M allocated to FXRP/RLUSD, about 2.1% of Sentora RLUSD Main deposits; FXRP represented about 2.5% of the vault's lending collateral.
claims.interpretation: The FXRP market is meaningful as a live institutional-curated collateral integration but remains a small slice of the overall RLUSD vault.
limitations: Snapshot is earlier than the 17:21 UTC market-level capture; do not combine as synchronized balances.

claims.statement: The two largest Sentora RLUSD Main depositors represented approximately 39.1% and 35.8% of vault deposits in the 09:01 UTC snapshot.
claims.interpretation: Concentration at the vault depositor level can create withdrawal/liquidity risk distinct from borrower concentration in the FXRP market.
limitations: Addresses are pseudonymous; beneficial ownership is unknown.

claims.statement: Morpho's Ethereum market interface identifies market ID 0x4fa31e3f8ba345227d44e1cf48559eea53a90dd5311dc006984c060f2f311d96, created 2026-07-28, with FXRP collateral and RLUSD debt.
claims.interpretation: This is the canonical market identifier for future pinned-block and event-history ingestion.
limitations: This pass captured the interface state, not a raw RPC response or block-pinned contract state.

claims.statement: The Morpho interface shows 77% LLTV, 7.41% liquidation penalty, 57 borrowers, approximately USD 8.44M outstanding loans, USD 909K total liquidity, and no realized or unrealized bad debt.
claims.interpretation: Protocol UI independently corroborates the scale and key risk parameters reported by MorphoWatch.
limitations: The interface values were captured during the same general observation window and are not fully independent of Morpho's own API.

claims.statement: Morpho's interface shows recent 2026-11-02 FXRP collateral supply and RLUSD borrowing transactions, confirming the market is active at capture.
claims.interpretation: This is stronger than a static listing: transactions were occurring in the market on November 2.
limitations: The displayed transaction sample is not a full event-log export or exhaustive activity history.

claims.statement: Flare's 2025-05-02 article uses the phrase 'actual capital deployment' to describe stablecoins turning interest into liquidity provision in XRPFi.
claims.interpretation: This is the likely source context for the phrase; it is a narrative description, not a standardized accounting definition.
limitations: The article is dated 2025 and its USD 140B USDT liquidity reference is broad market liquidity, not capital deployed on Flare.

claims.statement: The same 2025 Flare article reported USD 60M USDt0 minted in a few days and Flare TVL above USD 85M during that historical launch period.
claims.interpretation: Historical project-reported launch metrics; not current November 2026 balances.
limitations: Do not use as current TVL, current USDt0 supply or current available XRPFi liquidity.

claims.statement: CoinDesk reported on 2026-08-04 that FXRP was accepted as collateral in Sentora's RLUSD vault on Morpho and described the isolated market, risk review and multi-step mint/bridge/borrow flow.
claims.interpretation: Independent reporting corroborates the market launch and its institutional-curation context.
limitations: CoinDesk's article initially reported the broader USD 280M vault size, not the FXRP market's own borrow amount.

competing_hypotheses.statement: FXRP/RLUSD credit creates a genuine complementary use case: holders can access dollar liquidity without immediately selling native XRP exposure.
disconfirming_evidence: Borrowers incur variable interest and liquidation risk; collateral is FXRP rather than native XRP directly
unknowns: Whether loans fund purchases, working capital, hedging or other DeFi positions

competing_hypotheses.statement: The same credit market can create forced-supply pressure during sharp XRP/FXRP drawdowns because liquidators seize FXRP and may sell or redeem it.
disconfirming_evidence: Current realized bad debt is zero and observed liquidations are small
unknowns: Correlation of collateral price and RLUSD liquidity

competing_hypotheses.statement: RLUSD liquidity and XRP collateral are complementary: RLUSD is the debt asset and FXRP is the collateral asset.
disconfirming_evidence: This does not imply all RLUSD or all XRP demand benefits; market is small relative to the broader vault
unknowns: How much borrowed RLUSD leaves the vault or is re-deposited elsewhere

competing_hypotheses.statement: The high utilization and borrower concentration create idiosyncratic liquidity risk even with aggregate collateral coverage near 199%.
disconfirming_evidence: Isolated market design limits direct contagion to other Morpho markets; current bad debt is zero
unknowns: Curator cap changes and withdrawal behavior

competing_hypotheses.statement: FXRP DeFi deployment figures indicate more productive use than simple minted supply, but project-reported totals may include cross-chain representations and protocol accounting overlap.
disconfirming_evidence: Morpho market-level collateral is independently observable and active
unknowns: Unique collateral counted once across protocols
Net external capital deployed after internal transfers

data_quality_controls: Never add FXRP to native XRP supply; FXRP is a 1:1 representation backed by an agent/collateral system.
Do not count the same FXRP as separate economic supply when it moves across chains through OFT.
Separate FXRP supplied, RLUSD borrowed, total vault RLUSD deposits, and market utilization.
Do not infer that borrowed RLUSD was used to buy XRP; destination/use of loan proceeds is unknown.
Do not treat a liquidation as a confirmed native XRP spot sale until FXRP liquidation, transfer, redemption and execution routes are traced.
Keep project-reported Flare metrics distinct from MorphoWatch public-API/blockchain observations and Morpho protocol UI data.
Do not combine the 09:01 UTC vault snapshot and 17:21 UTC market snapshot as synchronized balances.
Treat the 20% price-drop estimate as a stress scenario, not a forecast or guaranteed liquidation amount.
Retain borrower and depositor concentration separately; pseudonymous addresses do not establish beneficial ownership.
Do not treat broad USDT market capitalization as liquidity deployed on Flare.

The phrase 'actual capital deployment' is marketing language; define actual capital using net external deposits, outstanding debt, collateral posted and realized settlement with double-count controls.
next_actions: Pin the Morpho market state to a specific Ethereum block and retrieve raw market state, positions, oracle values and events from two independent providers.
Resolve the full FXRP token contract, FAssets Core Vault backing and agent collateral/solvency data.
Trace the 57 borrower positions, especially the top three, without inferring beneficial ownership.
Trace liquidation transactions through FXRP seizure, transfers, redemptions and any exchange/DEX execution.
Measure how much borrowed RLUSD is withdrawn, swapped, bridged, redeposited or retained.
Reconcile Flare's 145.2M minted / 130M deployed figures with unique FXRP supply across Flare and destination chains.
Track Morpho LLTV, utilization, free liquidity, borrow/supply rates, oracle heartbeat and liquidation events at fixed intervals.
Keep this credit-utility feature separate from spot net buying pressure in the XRP prediction model.
